name: JoAi: Update Item

description.en: Edit the details of an existing item such as its title, description, status, priority, due date, tags, or linked contacts.
description.de: Bearbeite die Details eines bestehenden Elements, z. B. Titel, Beschreibung, Status, Priorität, Fälligkeit, Tags oder verknüpfte Kontakte.
description.es: Edit the details of an existing item such as its title, content, or status.
description.fr: Edit the details of an existing item such as its title, content, or status.
description.ro: Edit the details of an existing item such as its title, content, or status.
description.it: Edit the details of an existing item such as its title, content, or status.

bot: Use this when the user wants to modify an existing item. If the user refers to an item by title, list items first to find the matching ID. Pass contactIds as a JSON array of contact hashids to (re)assign contacts.

inputs.name: Item ID

description.en: The ID of the item to update
description.de: Die ID des zu aktualisierenden Elements
description.es: The ID of the item to update
description.fr: The ID of the item to update
description.ro: The ID of the item to update
description.it: The ID of the item to update

inputs.bot: The item hash ID. If the user refers to an item by title, list items first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Title
inputs.bot: A new title for this item, if the user wants to rename it.

inputs.name: Description

description.en: Updated description or body of the item
description.de: Aktualisierte Beschreibung oder Text des Elements
description.es: Updated description or body of the item
description.fr: Updated description or body of the item
description.ro: Updated description or body of the item
description.it: Updated description or body of the item

inputs.bot: The updated description/body for this item.

inputs.name: Status
inputs.bot: The new status for this item (e.g., active, done, archived).

inputs.name: Priority
inputs.bot: Priority level: normal, high, or critical.

inputs.name: Due Date
inputs.bot: Optional due date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

inputs.name: Tags
inputs.bot: Array of stable slugs. Pass a JSON array of strings. Replaces existing tags.

inputs.name: Goal ID
inputs.bot: Optional goal hash ID. Pass empty string to clear.

inputs.name: Contact IDs
inputs.bot: Array of contact hash IDs to assign to this item (replaces existing). Pass as JSON array. Pass [] to clear.
